name: Employee Handbook
description: Two-page HR handbook template with company policies, code of conduct, and benefits.

0.content:
Welcome to [Company Name]! We are thrilled to have you join our team. This handbook is designed to help you understand our culture, policies, and the resources available to you.

Our mission is to [mission statement]. Every team member plays a vital role in achieving this goal, and we are committed to supporting your professional growth.

All employees are expected to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and integrity:

• Treat colleagues, clients, and partners with respect and dignity
• Maintain confidentiality of company and client information
• Avoid conflicts of interest — disclose any potential conflicts promptly
• Comply with all applicable laws and regulations
• Use company resources responsibly and for business purposes only
• Report any ethical concerns to your manager or HR

Standard work hours are [X] hours per week, [start time] to [end time], [days per week]. We offer flexible scheduling arrangements subject to manager approval.

Employees must notify their manager at least [X] hours in advance for planned absences. For unplanned absences, please call or message your manager before your scheduled start time.

Your compensation package includes:

• Base salary paid [weekly/bi-weekly/monthly] on [day]
• [X] paid vacation days per year
• [X] sick days per year
• Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) — effective [date]
• Retirement plan with [X]% company match
• Professional development budget of [$X] per year

1.content:
Vacation Leave: Request time off through [system/process] at least [X] days in advance. Approval is at manager discretion based on business needs.

Sick Leave: Notify your manager by [time] on the day of absence. Medical documentation may be required for absences exceeding [X] consecutive days.

Parental Leave: [X] weeks of paid parental leave after [X] months of employment.

Bereavement Leave: Up to [X] days for immediate family.

Performance reviews are conducted [quarterly/annually] to discuss achievements, goals, and growth opportunities. Managers and employees work together to create a development plan aligned with both personal aspirations and company objectives.

We encourage continuous learning. Employees may use their professional development budget for courses, conferences, certifications, or educational materials with manager approval.

Company devices and networks are to be used primarily for business purposes. Personal use should be minimal and not interfere with productivity.

• Use strong, unique passwords and enable two-factor authentication
• Report any security incidents or suspicious activity immediately
• Do not install unauthorized software on company devices
• Company data must not be stored on personal devices without approval
• Follow the [specific] policy for handling customer data
I acknowledge that I have received and read the [Company Name] Employee Handbook. I understand that this handbook is a guide and does not constitute an employment contract.
